decisions.reason: Despite two years without visible promotion, transactional email is closely tied to the firm’s cloud messaging direction and is likely worth retaining as a core capability unless clearer evidence of weak demand emerges.

After several years and no visible follow-on presence, this more peripheral document-capture offer appears to have revealed limited standalone value, so resources are better shifted to stronger core and newer options.
This conversion service likely remains inexpensive to carry and still supports regulated and legacy customer processes, so keeping the option open is preferable while residual demand persists.
As a close-to-core fax optimization feature with probably low carrying cost, it still complements the installed base and is not yet compelling enough to abandon.

Although security fits the firm’s positioning, the lack of visible continuation over time suggests this specific sandbox offer has not become a strong enough option relative to other security and development priorities.
